headline: Loops: 1 limit, 1 plan name changed (removed “100 subscribers”; added “100 1.5m+”)
added: The free plan is for early products and smaller audiences.

The free plan includes up to 4,000 sends a month to 1,000 stored subscribed contacts. We do not charge for additional stored contacts. It also includes Loops branding at the bottom of your emails. Any paid plan will remove these limitations.

Loops is free to start, with no credit card required and you can invite your entire team to help you make a decision. We believe we've built the best tool in our class. If you need to send email for your SaaS, we can confidently say Loops is likely the right choice.

headline: Loops: pricing page text changed (no price or limit change detected)
added: Loops pricing is based on subscribed contacts. Transactional email sending is included at no additional charge on paid plans, and the free plan includes monthly sends for getting started.

headline: Loops: 1 limit changed (added “Up to 10 emails per second”)
added: Paid plans don’t cap the total number of emails you can send. Each team can send up to 1,000 emails per second. Free accounts can send up to 10 emails per second. Emails over the rate limit are enqueued until they can be sent.
